description:
**The Tracearr patches are now universal patches.**

I originally wrote "Unlock Premium" and "Disable Expo OTA updates" for Tracearr specifically, not realizing existing universal patches (e.g. [hoo-dles' Pairip patch](https://github.com/hoo-dles/morphe-patches)) would've gotten me close. The mechanisms were never Tracearr-specific: Pairip's license classes are injected unobfuscated by Google into every protected app, and the expo-updates toggle applies to any Expo app, so both are now available for any app you patch:

- **"Unlock Premium" → "Disable Pairip license check"** (now also covers Pairip's trial-end path)
- **"Disable Expo OTA updates"** (unchanged behavior, any Expo app)

Bonus: unlike patches that fake a successful response, this one no-ops the check entirely, so it works on degoogled devices with no Play Store or microG needed.

Both are now **off by default**, enable them per app in Morphe. If you had "Unlock Premium" enabled for Tracearr, re-enable it under its new name.
